title: NOT IN broken by NULL
description: Fix the query so it returns databases with no active sessions. sessions may contain rows with database_id = NULL; those rows must not make the result empty. Return exactly one column: database_name. Sort by database_name ASC.
starter_sql:
SELECT name AS database_name
FROM databases
WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT database_id FROM sessions WHERE state = 'active')
ORDER BY name ASC;
hints: A NULL inside NOT IN turns comparisons for other values into UNKNOWN.
A correlated NOT EXISTS avoids this problem.
solution_explanation: NOT EXISTS checks active-session existence per database and is unaffected by NULL in unrelated rows.
